_handoff.scopeNote: Unauthenticated public-workflow pass for Bengaluru municipal property-tax/khata name transfer and mutation. Current official public pages were inspected for visible controls, labels, and recovery handoffs only. No property, identity, contact, payment, login, objection, or application data was entered or submitted.
_handoff.observationNote: Direct current public-interface observations are Grade B. A visible service entry is not proof of eligibility, populated records, or an end-to-end sequence. Login-gated and property-specific steps remain Unknown.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi search exposes Ward Name or Ward Number, Property ePID, and SAS Property Tax ID as lookup options, and the page notes that a ward can be found on the property-tax receipt.
claims.notes: Controls and instructions only; no property lookup was run.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi page says that if the property is not found in the available searches, a person can select Do Not Find My Property eKhata for Bengaluru City Corporation to check and revert.
claims.notes: The entry is visible; no details were entered and no request was submitted.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi citizen page exposes an entry labelled eKhata Automatic Mutations - Get Your Mutation.
claims.notes: A visible entry does not establish that mutation is automatic or available for a particular property.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi citizen instructions say mobile/OTP login is used to see or download Draft eKhata and list registered deed, Aadhaar eKYC, SAS Property Tax Application Number, property photo, A-Khata proof, and a conditional encumbrance certificate as additional Final eKhata information.
claims.notes: Published labels are not proof of universal requirements or upload acceptance; no login/upload occurred.

claims.text: The public Pending Mutation Report exposes fields for registered-deed or mutation-application date, mutation basis, property EPID, giving and receiving parties, public-notice date, pending-with-whom state, and File Objection.
claims.notes: The unfiltered public table displayed No Data Available; columns do not establish a row, eligibility, or outcome.

claims.text: The public e-Khata Application Status page accepts an EPID, exposes stage/from/received/sent/sent-to/status/remarks columns, says status can be watched online under a waiting-list disposition, and publishes helpline 9480683695.
claims.notes: No EPID was entered, so no property-specific status/error was observed.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi payment page labelled Online payment for Khatha Transfer exposes ward/property/mutation fields, applicant name/mobile/email, total amount, card/UPI/net-banking modes, and convenience-charge text.
claims.notes: The generated page was viewed without a property context; amount, applicability, and payment completion are Unknown.

claims.text: The public payment notice directs a user to their bank for online-payment failure or auto-refund and to the ARO when money is deducted but not updated in e-Aasthi.
claims.notes: Recovery handoffs are visible; refund timing and evidence requirements are not.

claims.text: The public BBMP Property Tax System page lists Name and Address change under property corrections and directs name/receipt discrepancy users to Find Your ARO, with Revenue contact details and business hours.
claims.notes: The page marks its feature list as last updated 27-06-2017; current correction eligibility and outcome are not established.

claims.text: The public e-Aasthi system exposes a Find ARO details by Ward Name entry.
claims.notes: No ward was selected; the jurisdiction-specific office result remains unobserved.

claims.text: The unauthenticated pass does not establish post-login fields, document validation, rejection messages, objection form fields, or upload-to-status handoff for a particular property.
claims.notes: No login, upload, search, mutation, objection, or property-specific status action was performed.

claims.text: No reviewed unauthenticated page establishes a complete current sequence from property-tax record or registered deed through mutation, notice, payment, final e-Khata, and updated property-tax register, or a service-level time for that sequence.
claims.notes: Separate public entry points were observed, but their relationship and outcome were not verified.

edges.label: A public lookup can lead to an EPID/status entry, but no property-specific handoff was tested.
The public mutation report is a separate entry; its relationship to a particular lookup is not established.
Mutation metadata and EPID status are separate public surfaces; case-level linkage is unverified.
The payment notice names the ARO as a recovery contact when a deducted payment is not updated.
Missing-property fallback and ARO lookup are both visible, but the page does not prove they are one sequence.

roadblocks.title: Authenticated form and objection handling unobserved
roadblocks.symptom: Draft/Final eKhata, upload, and objection labels are public but their forms and validation are not visible unauthenticated.

roadblocks.recovery: Use only the authorised public/login route when ready; current fields and rejection recovery remain Unknown.

roadblocks.title: Payment or name correction needs an ARO/bank handoff

roadblocks.recovery: For a payment failure use the stated bank/ARO handoff; for a name discrepancy use the ward-based ARO route.

journeys.title: Payment or name discrepancy
journeys.context: Public pages expose payment failure and name-correction handoffs without proving a live demand, correction eligibility, or completion.

steps.label: Inspect payment context
steps.action: Use a legitimate property-specific payment URL only when supplied by the authorised system; this pass viewed labels only.
steps.expectedResult: Payment fields and modes may be shown; amount and applicability remain Unknown.

steps.label: Follow stated failure handoff
steps.action: For a real payment failure, follow the page's bank or ARO direction without repeating payment blindly.
steps.expectedResult: A published recovery contact, not a verified refund/update.

steps.label: Find jurisdictional ARO
steps.action: Use the ward-based ARO lookup for a name or receipt discrepancy.
steps.expectedResult: A public contact route; current correction outcome remains Unknown.

documentationQualityNotes: Payment surface is current public observation; name-correction list is explicitly legacy/undated.
